protocol.excluded: model loading/startup, provenance validation, file hashing, output-file writing
protocol.included: crop loading/decode, preprocessing, detector inference, postprocessing; TrustPCB also transforms, matching, aggregation, Beta application, weighted risk
protocol.order: repetition 1 baseline then TrustPCB, repeated for all five repetitions
protocol.population: 821 frozen development-manifest images; deterministic manifest order
protocol.reference_inclusion: original post-NMS confidence >= 0.01; original/transformed extraction floor 0.001
protocol.standard_deviation: sample standard deviation across five repetitions, ddof=1
protocol.timing: wall-clock perf_counter; CUDA synchronize after warmup and immediately before/after every repetition
protocol.warmup: first 20 development crops for each pipeline; untimed

transformation_rules.affine_border: constant per-original-image channel-wise median; grid-constant bilinear interpolation
transformation_rules.aggregation: mean within evaluable family, then equal mean across evaluable families
transformation_rules.blur: scipy gaussian_filter sigma=(0.6,0.6,0), reflect boundary, truncate=4.0; no channel mixing
transformation_rules.contrast: single scalar mean over all original pixels and channels
transformation_rules.coordinates: xy edge coordinates; pixel centres (column+0.5,row+0.5); image bounds [0,width] x [0,height]
transformation_rules.matching: class-agnostic IoU>=0.50; maximise cardinality then total polygon IoU
transformation_rules.rotation: positive counterclockwise visually, centre (width/2,height/2); unchanged canvas
transformation_rules.ties: source reference order; transformed detections sorted by xyxy then detector index; deterministic SciPy assignment; no class/confidence tie weights
